say:2:1041504201:1.text: I know what you're thinking, but I want you to focus on studying the Void Relic. No distractions.
say:2:1041504201:1.source_cn: 维珀里安，我知道你在盘算什么，你要做的只有研究班题斯圣...

say:3:1041504202:1.text: Naturally, Captain. Battles come and go, but knowledge? Now that is eternal—knowledge never stabs you in the back.
say:3:1041504202:1.source_cn: 当然，当然，胜利和失败都是一时的，只有永恒的知识，不会背叛。

say:4:1041504203:1.text: With my expertise, you're edging toward true immortality, yet even that is just the beginning. You'll need more... refinement.
say:4:1041504203:1.source_cn: 在我的帮助下，您已经无限接近永恒，但这还不够，您还需要...

say:5:1041504204:1.text: To truly rise again, you must shed the remnants of your past self. Evolution through... elimination.
say:5:1041504204:1.source_cn: 锤炼，将让您再度崛起，只有杀死了旧的您，新的您才会更加强大。

say:6:1041504205:1.text: I know you question my loyalty, but haven't I kept my promise? I've delivered power to you in more ways than one.
say:6:1041504205:1.source_cn: 为什么要怀疑我的忠诚呢？我一直在践行给您的承诺——以各...

say:7:1041504206:1.source_cn: 难道我在您面前做错过什么吗？

say:8:1041504207:1.source_cn: 维珀里安，我不否认你是个优秀的下属。

say:9:1041504208:1.text: But don't forget, you're only valuable as long as you're useful.
say:9:1041504208:1.source_cn: 但你最好确保，你一直对我有用。

say:10:1041504209:1.text: Fail me, and I'll grind you—and that slithering pet of yours—down to dust.
say:10:1041504209:1.source_cn: 否则……我会一寸一寸捏碎你和你那条骨蛇的脊骨……

say:11:1041504210:1.text: Ah, a tantalizing proposition, Captain. Pain is quite the teacher, but I'd rather delay that particular lesson.
say:11:1041504210:1.source_cn: 啊，苦痛确实能令意志更加伟大。不过您还不必将那种令人进...

say:12:1041504211:1.text: Rest assured, I'll prove my worth. You'll have my finest, dear captain...
say:12:1041504211:1.source_cn: 我会尽力证明自己的价值，敬爱的船长……
